findings.text: The company was incorporated on 27 October 1987 and ceased trading on 22 December 2025.
A members' voluntary liquidation was recorded, with the company wound up on 20 May 2025 and dissolved on 22 December 2025.
Accounts were last made up to 31 December 2023, and the confirmation statement was last made up to 5 March 2025.
The status of both accounts and the confirmation statement is unknown, with no next due date recorded.
One person with significant control is recorded: CORPORATE CONTROLLER 1141, which holds between 75 and 100 percent of shares.
No charges are registered against the company.
Director D. WHITE has 11 other appointments, including one in liquidation, across the network of companies checked.
No officer appointments, resignations, or registered office address changes were filed since 24 October 2025.
